svg.title: Legacy vs High-Performance HMI
svg.desc: Side-by-side comparison of legacy 'Christmas Tree' graphics (rainbow pipes, neon green running pumps, raw digital readouts, drowned alarm) versus ANSI/ISA-101.01 High-Performance HMI (grayscale discipline, MAI moving bar, neutral pointer, Method 3 alarm reservation).

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Legacy 'Christmas Tree' HMI vs. ANSI/ISA-101.01 High-Performance HMI

svg.text: ⚠️ Alarm is drowned out by neon green pumps and rainbow pipes!

svg.text: • Normal running state uses 100% saturation neon colors (foveal fatigue).

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • 'Stopped' pump rendered in bright red confuses operators during emergency events.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Raw digital numbers (42.8 bar) give zero context of danger thresholds or trend.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Serial visual search required: Saccadic search time > 15 seconds in plant upsets.
